The expanded abstract *Leveraging LLM-based Assistants for Geoscientific Software* by Denis Anikiev, Umair bin Waheed, and Korhan Ayranci has been published in the proceedings of the Fifth International Meeting for Applied Geoscience & Energy.

The study evaluates how large language model assistants, supported by retrieval-augmented generation and prompt engineering, can help users work with complex geoscientific software. Using the IGMAS+ 3D modeling platform as a case study, the authors compared assistant responses with expert guidance for both introductory and advanced questions.
